tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark: violet-black night. Light: warm paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the collapsed sticky header.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Raised or hovered elements, inputs, chips at rest, the active row of a list.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Never the only way to tell two things apart.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on ground, surface and surface-2 (12.9:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, labels (5.9:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: Decorative text and disabled controls only. Fails 4.5:1 for small text, so never use it for anything a person has to read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Per-anime accent FILL: active tab bar, focus ring, glows, the cover outline, progress. Replaced at runtime by the anime's cover colour (AniList coverImageColor); this teal is the fallback when there is none. Text on it uses on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as TEXT and links on ground and surface. At runtime it is derived from the anime's colour by moving lightness until it reaches 4.5:1 on ground in the current theme.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an accent fill (8.8:1 on the fallback teal). Check it against each anime's colour; switch to white when the colour is dark.

tokens.name: neon-magenta
tokens.usage: Cyberpunk secondary: games, quizzes, 'live' and 'new' badges. One element per screen at most.

tokens.name: xp-gold
tokens.usage: Gamified moments: ranks, streaks, rewards, top-10 numbers. Never for warnings.

tokens.name: score-high
tokens.usage: Episode graph and score chips: score 8 and up. Blue, lighter than score-low, so the bands differ in lightness, not only in hue.

tokens.name: score-mid
tokens.usage: Episode graph and score chips: score 6 to 7.9.

tokens.name: score-low
tokens.usage: Episode graph and score chips: score under 6.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Success states: saved, imported, correct answer.

tokens.name: bad
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: failed import, wrong answer, delete.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The anime title in the expanded page header. One per page.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles and carousel headings on the home page.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles on cards and in the collapsed sticky header.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Centuries ago, mankind was slaughtered to near extinction by monstrous humanoid creatures called Titans.
styles.usage: Synopsis, reviews, any running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels: tab names, eyebrows, chip captions.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Scores, ranks, counts, episode numbers, countdowns. Always tabular figures.

styles.name: stat-lg
styles.usage: The headline score in the page header and stat tiles.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, inside chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips, between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, minimum page gutter on phones, the dot-grid pitch.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid or carousel.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a tab.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between major page bands (header, tabs, footer).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, score badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects (the season selector).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, cover art, panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the tab bar's active indicator, toggles, XP and streak counters.

breakpoint.note: Mobile first: styles start at phone width and add layout at each step.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Large phones: 3 cards per row in grids.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablets: header shows cover beside the title; tabs stop scrolling when they fit.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Desktop: two-column tab layouts (content plus side panel), 6 cards per row.
